messages.text: The harbour bell rang twice before anyone looked up.
messages.speaker: keeper

messages.text: Nobody in the village had seen that boat before.
messages.speaker: harbourmaster

messages.text: The harbour bell rang twice before the fog lifted.
messages.speaker: villager

messages.text: The harbour bell was missing from the wreck.
messages.speaker: villager

messages.text: Nobody in the village had mentioned the boat before.
messages.speaker: villager

messages.text: The keeper left the lamp burning all night.
messages.speaker: villager

messages.text: Someone had moved the crates before tide turn.
messages.speaker: villager

messages.text: The waterline was higher than the last chart said.
messages.speaker: villager

messages.text: A rowboat sat untied beneath the broken jetty.
messages.speaker: unknown

messages.text: Nobody mentioned the light that went out at dusk.
messages.speaker: unknown

messages.text: The harbourmaster kept his ledger in the upper drawer.
messages.speaker: unknown

messages.text: Something had been dragged across the slipway.
messages.speaker: unknown

messages.text: The tide would not turn for another hour.
messages.speaker: unknown

messages.text: Every window on the quay faced the same direction.
messages.speaker: unknown
